assessments.reasoning: The License Index’s SCOPE.md at cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7, bytes [640,783), admits additional permissions as exceptions. Totem calls the plugin permission “above and beyond” the GPL permissions.

GNOME/totem’s COPYING at 7bb879e1f6746ca19f99629794e918cdbbd06008 has the claimed digest. Its opening comment points to the added clause. The closing permission identifies the covered plugins, uses “this project” and expressly permits deletion from a modified version.

The Index decision at 318db58e06be8f6682a6cb1520f0300df7ebd2c4, bytes [4262,4482), assigns c5c10dee8ecf4f79a74641f03f23006f, GStreamer Exception (2008), edition totem-43-0-copying, revision sha256:8467c35c94d5ab31cd6556203bd651cfa9a6c293043d1d5a7defd0c046f0a02c, kind exception and lifecycle active.

challenge.method: Tested substitution of the historical GStreamer Exception (2005) row and checked the end of COPYING for evidence against project-wide GPL coverage.
challenge.results: The 2005 row identifies a Totem 1.0.5 header with a different ID and digest. The 43.0 witness contains generic project wording and the deletion option. Its final note identifies src/totem-subtitle-encoding.c as relicensed to LGPL, defeating a uniform-license inference.

limitations: The year is part of the reference name in the Index’s SPDX 3.29.0 mapping. First adoption in 2008 is unverified. The Index binds the Totem 43.0 edition to the captured digest. A release tag was not separately inspected.
COPYING prints GPL version 2 and records a file-specific LGPL relicensing. A later-version election, another file’s terms and later project practice require separate evidence.
Active is an Index maintenance value. Publisher currency, SPDX deprecation, work-specific use, redistribution rights and release authorization remain separate questions.
reasoning: Totem’s pinned COPYING permits non-GPL-compatible GStreamer plugins to be used and distributed together with GStreamer and “this project.” It expressly lets a modifier omit the exception. The Index identifies this specimen as GStreamer Exception (2008) and assigns it active.
